text:
samir patel: proposal: add a config-diff preview in console + shadow-apply mode before any rollout. shadow-apply would route X% of traffic to evaluate new routing predicates + quota changes without committing. dry-run tomorrow 14:00 UTC.

emma cho: love preview. question: do we show exact runtime evaluated predicates (post-template) or just raw config diff? ops needs evaluated view.

samir patel: evaluated view. console shows diff + sample resolved predicate examples for a few common user hashes. also show predicted quota impact (tokens/sec delta) per model.

li wei: on implementation: two internal API semantics debated: `apply_patch` (merge diff, keep existing defaults) vs `replace_config` (atomic swap). Patch is safer for small overrides; replace is simpler for rollbacks. which do we pick?

drew silva: prefer both. expose `apply_patch` with schema validation + dry-run validation; `replace_config` reserved for infra owners. console should default to patch for safety.

emma cho: shadow-apply flow: route 0.5% traffic for 10m then evaluate telemetry. need metrics: tokens, lat95, error rate, quota_throttles, and routing-match-count. include `telemetry.preview=true` tag.

li wei: also need a checksum on the resolved config we use in shadow so audit logs point to exact binary. add `config_sha256` to audit.

drew silva: autos-stop rule: if lat95 increases > 30% or errors > 2x baseline -> auto-pause and create incident draft in console. ops-bot should create a thread.

ops-bot: scheduled job created: `shadow-apply-dryrun` -> staging at 2867891800.

emma cho: UX: preview should show cumulative match % per predicate and an example of an affected request (headers + route). also show a small diff of quota tables and a preflight checklist link.

samir patel: good. add deterministic assignment using `request_id % bucket_count` for shadow routing to avoid churn. make bucket_count visible in preview.

li wei: preflight checklist: schema validation, perf test (50-150 qps mix), telemetry tags wired, checksum audit, console preview + pause button, notify support.

drew silva: minor API note: when `apply_patch` hits an invalid field we should fail-fast rather than partial apply. no partial configs in prod.

emma cho: can we show an estimated rollback command in console after preview? one click rollback to previous sha.

samir patel: yes. rollback link + auto-generated CLI invocation. i'll open the RFC and PR for console and API today. thanks team.
